process.title: From Log to Load-Out.
process.subtitle: Six controlled production stages inside our workshops ensure uniform core density, zero internal voids, and seaworthy arrival at your port.

steps.step1Desc: Selected logs are rotary-peeled to uniform thickness, kiln-dried to 8–12% moisture content, and sorted by grain integrity.
steps.step2Desc: Veneers are roller-coated with calibrated phenolic or melamine WBP resin and assembled in perpendicular cross-grain plies.
steps.step3Desc: Cold-pressed and first-stage hot-pressed base panels pass through heavy-duty drum sanders to achieve ±0.3mm thickness uniformity.
steps.step4Desc: Phenolic impregnated film is thermally fused onto the calibrated substrate under controlled temperature and hydraulic pressure.
steps.step5Desc: Precision CNC saws square all four edges before triple-coat waterproof acrylic edge sealing and stencil branding.
steps.step6Desc: Bundles are wrapped in moisture-barrier film, reinforced with steel straps on export pallets, and loaded directly into 40HQ containers.

About.title: Built on Timber Craft & Industrial Precision.
About.lead: Senweida Trading Co., Ltd. (徐州森炜达贸易有限公司) is a specialized China-based manufacturer and international exporter of plywood, film faced construction formwork, and engineered structural timber.
About.storyP1: Operating from China's core timber processing and plywood manufacturing belt in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province, Senweida bridges raw veneer milling directly with international B2B trade execution. Rather than acting as a generalist broker, our operations are dedicated strictly to structural wood panels and concrete formwork systems.
About.storyP2: Every shipment is manufactured to the buyer's exact engineering brief — whether that calls for economical finger-joint shuttering for residential housing or twice-hot-pressed eucalyptus hardwood formwork for high-rise cores and bridge infrastructure.
About.capabilityIntro: Our production process integrates modern hydraulic hot pressing, automated thickness calibration, and strict moisture control:
About.cap1Desc: Heavy-duty multi-head calibration sanders remove core thickness variations prior to film lamination, preventing wave distortion on poured concrete walls.
About.cap2Desc: High-pressure thermal bonding cycles cure phenolic and melamine WBP adhesives evenly through every veneer layer.
About.cap3Desc: Automated four-edge trimming, triple-layer waterproof acrylic edge painting, and custom brand stencil printing for regional distributors.
About.fscDesc: We are committed to sustainable timber utilization. We source fast-growing plantation poplar and eucalyptus alongside legally verified hardwood veneers under FSC Chain-of-Custody standards, supporting green building compliance for international contractors.

fscSection.title: FSC Certified Responsible Forestry

qcSteps.title: Five-Point Mill Inspection Protocol
qcSteps.q1Desc: Every batch of rotary-cut poplar and eucalyptus core veneer is tested with digital pin moisture meters after kiln drying to prevent steam blisters during hot pressing.
qcSteps.q2Desc: Random cut samples from each press shift are submerged in boiling water for up to 72 hours to verify phenolic WBP resin cross-linking and bond integrity.
qcSteps.q3Desc: Inspectors measure 8 points around each sheet with digital calipers (±0.3mm to ±0.5mm tolerance) and verify diagonal length accuracy within ±1mm.
qcSteps.q4Desc: Sample panels are sawn across the width to inspect internal lamination density, ensuring zero core gaps that could cause site cracking.
qcSteps.q5Title: Triple-Coat Waterproof Edge Paint & Film Adhesion
qcSteps.q5Desc: All four edges are sealed with heavy-build waterproof acrylic paint to block moisture absorption on construction sites.

packaging.title: Seaworthy Export Packaging & Container Load-Out
packaging.subtitle: Engineered to endure long-distance ocean freight and forklift handling without corner crushing or humidity damage.
packaging.p1Desc: Every bundle is fully wrapped in 0.2mm waterproof plastic film to block marine condensation during ocean transit.
packaging.p2Desc: All six sides are armored with protective MDF/plywood cover boards or heavy export carton sheets with reinforced corner protectors.
packaging.p3Desc: Secured with 4×8 high-strength steel straps on reinforced export skid pallets for safe forklift unloading at destination ports.
